title: Lunar laser reflectors

tellings.quote: "Ah, you know, we can see the the laser. We can put a laser on some of the things that we left on the surface of the moon."

plain: Scientists are said to be able to aim lasers from Earth at equipment the Apollo astronauts left on the Moon between 1969 and 1972, and see the light come back. The documentary filmmaker James Fox tells Michels this, repeating what a man he calls Ben told him: "We can put a laser on some of the things that we left on the surface of the moon." It comes up as evidence that the Moon landings left real objects behind.
